An access token from a session that carried many claims, captured while
debugging a 401. The payload segment is 2647 bytes: past the 1,003 the rule's
bounded pattern could reach before the extent replaced it, and the shape a
corpus of documentation samples does not hold.

  Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCIsImtpZCI6InNwaWxsLWd1YXJkLWZpeHR1cmUifQ..ZmT4bXn9Ld6VcP1HkBe7Y1SvMpGjAd6X0RuLoFi_c5W

The payload decodes to JSON carrying the fabricated stem this directory is
marked with. The signature is fabricated too -- it is not an HMAC of anything,
so jwt-sample-key has nothing to recompute and nothing to suppress.
